name: Kiso (Japan, town)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kiso town emblem in blue: a stylised sail-like stroke above elliptical rings.
history: Municipal flag of Kiso, a town in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 2005.

features.role: Kiso town emblem — a stylised sail-like stroke above elliptical rings
